name: Liquid Prescription Medicine
description: Guidelines for traveling with liquid prescription medicine in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Prescription liquid medications are allowed in carry-on bags in quantities larger than 3.4 oz, but they must be declared to TSA officers at the checkpoint for separate screening.
conditions: Do not mix liquid medicines in your standard toiletries bag.
The officer may inspect the medicine manually or test the liquid.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring liquid prescription medicine on a plane?

travelTips: Do not mix liquid medicines in your standard toiletries bag.

faq.question: Is liquid prescription medicine allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Liquid Prescription Medicine is restricted in carry-on luggage. Prescription liquid medications are allowed in carry-on bags in quantities larger than 3.4 oz, but they must be declared to TSA officers at the checkpoint for separate screening.

faq.question: Can you pack liquid prescription medicine in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Liquid Prescription Medicine is allowed in checked bags.
